up: List all distinct molecules that are reported in the document identified by the ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL2163248'. A molecule is considered reported in this document if it appears in the compound_records table with the same doc_id as the document. For each molecule, provide the following information: its ChEMBL identifier, preferred name, maximum clinical phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. If a molecule does not have a canonical SMILES record in the compound_structures table, show NULL for that column. Return only unique molecules based on the ChEMBL ID.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2163248';
